patch.value: state filter is applied client-side after --limit, under-returning on large teams

The Linear importer's --state flag was filtered CLIENT-SIDE in syncLinearIssues AFTER fetching --limit issues, and buildIssuesQuery had no state clause. So 'pm-linear import --limit 100 --state In Progress' fetched 100 issues (ordered by updatedAt) then dropped non-matching ones locally, returning far fewer than the matching issues that exist beyond the fetched window on large teams. Fix: add a server-side filter clause state.name.eq plus $state variable in buildIssuesQuery, mirroring the existing project/assignee/label/updatedSince clauses, threaded through FetchFilters/buildImportRequestPlan/syncLinearIssues. The client-side substring guard remains as a harmless backstop.
--state filters server-side via the GraphQL state.name.eq clause + variable; no clause when --state absent (zero regression); pure query-builder unit-tested
